n: 700 Series Front Load Washer with Smartboost® - 4.5 Cu. Ft.
desc: The Electrolux front load washer provides the most effective stain removal with SmartBoost premixing technology, even in cold water. With new features like Cold Sanitize and a Care Meter to help make sustainable selections easier, this machine is optimized to perform in cold water.
hl: The magnetic door prop allows washer door to stay ajar to completely dry out seal in between uses, reducing the risk of odor and mildew.
Quickly clean the items you need most
Remove bacteria and sanitize your way with our Cold Sanitize option paired with Lysol® Laundry Sanitizer or NSF® certified hot sanitize setting
Care Meter for more sustainable cycles
The Care Meter displays 1, 2, or 3 leaves depending on cycle selection to promote cycle choices that save water, energy, and are gentler on fabrics.
Easily cleans a king-sized comforter with extra large 4.5 Cu. Ft drum.
Remove 95% of allergens from your clothing, towels and bedding with our NSF®-certified Allergen option.
